candidates.title: ws-fresh-verify injection must be spawn-timeout bounded

proposedChange.change: Bound the injected test spawn with an explicit timeout (a killed child counts as a red signal) so a mutation that pins a monitor run active cannot hang the stage, and prefer assertion-failing mutations for counting ACs over ones that only change loop termination.

candidates.title: Re-score the AC ledger boundary before each pre-advance after a post-Step-5 edit

proposedChange.change: Record that the expected ac_ledger boundary alternates (pre-step6 before step 6, step5 before steps 7-8, ship before step 9) and that any product edit after Step 5 requires regenerate-integrity + re-link + re-score at the boundary the next pre-advance expects, or validate_state fails closed.
